parts.label: b
parts.technique: Linear transformation of a binomial random variable and its expectation
parts.reason: Requires E(M)=E(5X-25) using E(X)=np, i.e. calculation of the mean of a discrete random variable via linear transformation. S4.1 explicitly excludes 'calculation of mean and variance of discrete random variables'; the only exception (S5.1 guidance) is restricted to use of np in a hypothesis-test context, not this direct expectation derivation.

parts.label: c

parts.reason: This part only makes sense using the out-of-spec relation/answer established in part (b) (M in terms of X), so per the rule it is treated as out of spec even though the final binomial probability calculation itself would otherwise be in spec.
